_doc: Calls that never return and loops a function never leaves: a verification ends there (tools/noreturn_gen.py -> recomp/noreturn.inc for the bridge; tools/snap_replay.py and tools/reachfuzz.py read this file). callees: a function under test that calls one of these directly is compared at the callee's entry. points: an address in a function's own code (a spin loop) where it is compared.

points.0x000DE9F8: sub_000DE9B0 (watchdog thread): the spin after its vbail
points.0x000F0B86: CShell::MainLoop: the back edge, one pass compared (the loop runs until the game quits)
points.0x000633D0: sub_00063190: the spin after its last frames
points.0x0006A0E9: GExitMissionGoalsButton constructor 0x69F50: its frame loop (runs until the screen closes), one pass compared
